free_text: The patient is a 59-year-old male with a PSA of 7.2 and a prior biopsy grade of 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). MRI revealed a focal lesion in the right peripheral zone with restricted diffusion and early enhancement, but no extracapsular extension. Given the persistent low-grade disease and mild LUTS, active surveillance is recommended to weigh the benefit against potential treatment risks.
